purpose: The committed record of every Base runtime fact the fork claims check against. It is written once by an authorized discovery pass, reviewed, and committed; the final fork gate is check-only and never writes into it. A gate that observed a value and then compared it to itself would prove nothing, which is why this file exists as a separate, reviewed input.

status_meaning.discovery_pending: No authorized read-only Base provider has been available, so nothing has been observed. test-fork/ForkFixture.sol refuses to run a check pass while this file is in this state, and requirements/ledger.toml keeps every fork claim pending.
status_meaning.observed_and_committed: An authorized discovery pass recorded the values below, they were reviewed, and the final fork gate may check against them.

authority: SPEC.md section 3 binding table; contracts/autolaunch-release-manifest.json records the same bindings with their runtime facts still null and fork_pending.
endpoint: reached only through the configured `base` alias; no endpoint is ever recorded here

pinned.note: the pinned Base header this candidate's fork evidence was taken at

later.note: a later Base head captured for this same candidate; regent-4wx owns the ceremony-time fresh-head recheck

transaction_gas_schedule.note: the Base transaction gas rules active at each header, including any intrinsic calldata floor introduced after this repository's Cancun compile target; GAS-006 takes the applicable maximum of execution-plus-intrinsic and the calldata floor, never a naive sum

cca_factory.runtime_code_hash_source: SPEC.md section 3; this is the frozen admission expectation, not an observation

dead_address.runtime_bytes_source: the dead address must carry no code at all; that is the claim, not an observation

permit2.note: the canonical Permit2 deployment every bidder allowance goes through; its ABI is frozen from the pinned IAllowanceTransfer interface, its deployed runtime is a fork observation
